about: The same task and the same three agents, but all on a free Groq model.
how: A chain of three agents on one free provider.
learns: The free provider costs nothing and is quicker here: 5.9 seconds, 1,220 input and 1,223 output tokens. The answers are shorter, so the quality differs, and a free account has limits.
watch: The totals in Statistics against the twin: about a third of the time and a third of the output tokens, with no price.
